meta.title: {app} – paragliding community
meta.description: News, tips, gear market and flight logbook for paragliding pilots in Türkiye, by {club}.

home.heroText: News, tips from instructors, a second-hand gear market and your flight logbook, in one place. Free, by {club}.

tips.title: Tips & tricks
tips.text: Launching, thermalling, XC, weather and SIV, from beginner to advanced.

market.title: Gear market
market.text: New and used wings, harnesses, reserves and instruments.

logbook.title: Flight logbook
logbook.text: Import IGC/GPX files from your vario or app and see your stats.

sites.title: Sites
sites.text: Takeoffs and landings with wind directions and flyability.

safety.title: Safety
safety.text: Incident reports and lessons shared with the community.

comingSoon.title: Coming soon
comingSoon.text: This part of the app is being built. Check back soon.

auth.displayNameHelp: Shown to other pilots. You can change it later.
auth.birthDateHelp: You must be 14 or older. Pilots under 18 need a parent's or guardian's consent.
auth.passwordHelp: At least 10 characters, with letters and numbers.
auth.magicTitle: Sign in with an email link
auth.magicText: We'll email you a one-time sign-in link. No password needed.
auth.magicSent: If an account exists for that address, a sign-in link is on its way.
auth.signUpLegal: After creating your account you will see our privacy notice and terms before you can continue.
auth.checkEmailText: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it on this device to finish signing up.
auth.forgotText: Enter your email and we'll send you a reset link.
auth.forgotSent: If an account exists for that address, a reset link is on its way.
auth.signOutAllHelp: Ends every session, including on other phones and computers.

errors.emailNotConfirmed: Please confirm your email first. Check your inbox.
errors.tooYoung: You must be at least 14 years old to use {app}.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.weakPassword: Password is too weak. Use at least 10 characters with letters and numbers.
errors.userExists: An account with this email already exists. Try signing in.
errors.linkInvalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

age.title: Confirm your age
age.text: We need your date of birth to apply our minimum age (14) and to ask a parent or guardian for consent if you are under 18. It is kept private.

legal.title: Privacy notice and terms
legal.intro: Please read how we handle your data and the rules of the community.
legal.privacyAck: I have read the privacy notice.
legal.termsAccept: I accept the terms of use.
legal.updated: These texts have changed since you last accepted them.

consents.title: Your choices
consents.intro: These are optional. Nothing is pre-selected, and you can change your mind at any time on the Privacy page.

guardian.title: Parent or guardian consent
guardian.text: Because you are under 18, a parent or legal guardian has to confirm your account. We'll email them a link. Your account becomes active once they confirm.
guardian.name: Parent or guardian's name
guardian.sent: Email sent to {email}. The link is valid for 7 days.

marketing_notifications.title: Club news and offers
marketing_notifications.text: Emails and notifications about club events, offers and announcements.

analytics.title: Usage statistics
analytics.text: Pseudonymised statistics and error reports that help us improve the app.

public_profile.title: Public profile
public_profile.text: Show the public parts of your profile to visitors who are not signed in and to search engines.

live_location.title: Live location sharing
live_location.text: Share your live position through a temporary link while you fly.

incident_special_category.title: Health data in incident reports
incident_special_category.text: Process injury details you include in an incident report.

guardianConfirm.title: Confirm your child's account
guardianConfirm.intro: {guardian}, {name} has asked you to confirm their account on {app}, the paragliding community app of {club}.
guardianConfirm.what: If you confirm, their account becomes active. Their profile stays private by default, they cannot post in the gear market, and adults they do not follow cannot message them. You can ask us to delete the account at any time by writing to {email}.
guardianConfirm.confirm: I am the parent or legal guardian and I give my consent
guardianConfirm.confirmed: Thank you. The account is now active.
guardianConfirm.invalid: This link is invalid, has expired or was already used.

profile.photoHelp: JPEG, PNG or WebP. We shrink it and remove location data before upload.
profile.licenceHelp: Optional. Only you can see it; it is stored encrypted.
profile.minorNote: Because you are under 18, your profile is private by default.

privacy.consentsText: Turn any of these on or off. Changes take effect immediately.
privacy.exportText: A JSON file with everything we store about you. Flight files will be added when the logbook launches.
privacy.requestText: Object to processing, ask for a correction or anything else. We answer within 30 days.
privacy.deleteText: Your profile is anonymised immediately and you are signed out everywhere. After 30 days your account and all its data are permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
privacy.deleted: Your account has been deleted. It will be permanently removed after 30 days.

legal.notFound: This document is not available yet.

common.reportSent: Thank you. Our moderators will review it.
common.minorRestricted: This is not available for accounts under 18.

news.title: News
news.lead: Announcements, trips and safety notices from {club}.
news.likes: {count, plural, =0 {No likes} one {# like} other {# likes}}
news.commentRules: Be kind. Comments that break the rules are removed.
news.membersOnlyLocked: This article is for club members.

tips.title: Tips & tricks
tips.lead: Knowledge from instructors and experienced pilots, from your first launch to XC.
tips.suggestLead: Share what you have learned. An instructor or moderator reviews every suggestion before it is published.
tips.suggestSent: Thank you! Your tip was sent for review.
tips.videoInvalid: Only YouTube or Vimeo links are supported.
tips.safety: Tips do not replace training with a qualified instructor.
tips.videoNotice: The video is loaded from {host} only when you press play. {host} may then set cookies and see your IP address.

market.title: Gear market
market.lead: New and used paragliding gear from the club and pilots.
market.disclaimer: The club is not a party to sales between members. No payments happen in the app.
market.safetyNotice: Have used wings and reserves checked by a certified workshop before you fly them.
market.photosHelp: We shrink photos and remove location data before upload.
market.expiringSoon: Your ad “{title}” expires soon. Renew it to keep it online.
market.adultsOnly: You need to be 18 or older to post ads.
market.deleteConfirm: Delete this ad and its photos? This cannot be undone.

chat.title: Messages
chat.empty: No conversations yet. You can message a seller from an ad.
chat.blockedNotice: You can no longer message each other.
chat.error: Could not send. Please try again.
chat.minorProtected: This member can't receive new messages from adults.

notificationsSettings.text: Get notified on this device. You can change topics any time.
notificationsSettings.enabled: Notifications are on for this device.
notificationsSettings.unsupported: This browser does not support push notifications. On iPhone, add the app to your home screen first.
notificationsSettings.denied: Notifications are blocked in your browser settings.
notificationsSettings.topicNews: Club news (needs the “Club news and offers” consent)
notificationsSettings.consentLink: Turn on the “Club news and offers” consent in Privacy to receive club news.
